body:
Founder real-time: 'console.okemily.com added that needs to be where a customer can set up their instance which would set up its own subdomain - update the emily cli tool so there is a command for adding the cloudflare token - plan this task into subtasks into the inbox'. Per explicit instruction, planning only, no code shipped. Wrote 6 real, grounded subtasks into a new EMILY/BACKLOG.md SECTION 244, each citing real, already-checked facts from S243-06/07/08 rather than invented from scratch: S244-01 (tenants/trials table in IDUNA, the control plane), S244-02 (real provisioning pipeline: port allocation, fresh IDUNA_PRO instance + migrations, programmatic broker Route registration -- names the exact hand-edited-file gap S243-06 itself flagged), S244-03 (resolve the wildcard-vs-per-tenant TLS decision S243-06 left open), S244-04 (the actual console.okemily.com signup/status front-end, blocked on 01/02), S244-05 (a real, new emily.cli command for the Cloudflare API token -- decisive finding: certbot-dns-cloudflare's own credentials file is INI-format, not a shell env-export like emily key set's existing emily/iduna targets, needs its own new target/subcommand with real 0600 permissions and maskKey-style redaction on show), S244-06 (wire that credentials file into a real wildcard-cert issuance command, likely a new sudo-queue script). All 6 are real, open, uncarded BACKLOG.md items -- they'll surface in IDUNA's own kanban Inbox pane for triage into priority/cruise, matching the founder's own 'plan into subtasks into the inbox' request.

⚓ ☃
title: console.okemily.com + Cloudflare-token CLI command -- real subtask planning pass (SECTION 244)
